t: The Map Vent Fixed Louvre Vent provides essential fresh air ventilation and warm air system integration. Constructed from durable chrome stainless steel, this rectangular vent offers a robust solution for various applications, including those requiring ventilation for gas appliances. Its design ensures a free air space of 3400mm², promoting efficient air circulation. Measuring 229mm x 76mm, it is specifically designed to fully cover a single brick aperture, making installation straightforward with its surface-mounted capability. This fixed louvre vent is a practical choice for maintaining air quality and can comply with Building Regulation Part F when installed correctly.
